description: A dim, warmly lit laboratory or study painted in oil style. In the foreground a wooden desk holds a dark wooden box with a tilted mirror, and a sheet of paper with a drawn star outline and a pencil sits in front of it. A black articulated desk lamp is at left, with glass flasks and bottles on shelves behind. At right, a white lab coat hangs over the back of a wooden chair, with a blank clipboard on its seat. Background cabinets and electrical equipment fill the dark corners. No people, no visible text, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.
